capabilities: Sync a vault two-way across devices via the user's own Google Drive appDataFolder
Review uploads, downloads and deletes before the first sync
Keep both versions of notes edited on two devices as conflict copies
Refuse syncs that would delete most of a vault and warn on vault-name mismatches
Browse files stored on Google Drive and auto-sync every 60 seconds
extras: Early software: the README warns to back up the vault before the first sync since NSync moves and deletes files. No end-to-end encryption (Google can read appDataFolder files), .obsidian settings are not synced, and mobile has no background sync. Not in the community plugin browser at time of writing; install via BRAT or manual release download. Installation via BRAT is described at length but is only an install method.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid third-party service, and users who want to sync through their own Google Drive without a middleman have no built-in way to do it.

requires.name: Google account with a self-created Google Cloud OAuth client

summary: Two-way vault sync through the user's own Google Drive appDataFolder, with first-sync review, conflict copies and 60-second auto-sync on desktop and mobile.
